juliacrcl.reasoning: Creator does Vinted flipping/thrift-sourcing content. Audience is mixed: many general consumers commenting on Vinted's decline, arnaques, or wanting to buy items to wear; a hobbyist cluster asking beginner logistics (labels, statut auto-entrepreneur, formation, delays); and a smaller pro cluster genuinely asking sourcing questions ('où te fournis-tu pour le luxe'). Multiple accounts advertise their own Vinted handles or lots (self-promo, not sourcing). A clear coordinated spam campaign praises the tool 'Lbcx' in near-identical testimonial language across many accounts (lara_dnh, rechinah, myliahmaddy, laraa.evah, judi.te553, mimih4945) — excluded from all counts. Sourcing intent is present but minority, so general_consumer dominates.
